name: bos-trucking-site
description: Website for B.O.S. Trucking & Site, Inc. — Fort Myers, FL. Static HTML/CSS/JS, no framework, no build step.
comment: There are no runtime or build dependencies, and no node_modules is
required to run or edit this site. npm is used only as a familiar task
runner; every script shells out to Python 3 and the standard library,
plus Pillow for the image pipeline.
npm start    -> local preview at http://localhost:8080
npm run images -> regenerate public/img/** from assets/sources.json
npm run check  -> link, asset, accessibility and SEO checks
Pillow is the only external package, and only scripts/ needs it:
